actors.name: Oberon
actors.note: Cerebral palsy, wheelchair, twisted hands. Fairy familiars: the most physically constrained kid in the story has familiars that embody absolute freedom of movement. Art: a drawing from the DW tab, when Chris has one.

actors.name: Ayo
actors.note: Blind. Yoruba for Joy. Wheels Oberon; already a bonded pair.

actors.name: Bop
actors.note: Non-binary, speechless, autistic; they/them. Bop is the only sound they can make. Familiar: a bat that echolocates by calling bop bop. Lost in the belly of their alligator.

episodes.name: The Book
episodes.description: The illustrated book, one scene per page. Backdrops are Chris's drawings (DW tab -> Make a backdrop).

episodes.name: The Game
episodes.description: The one-switch game that comes after the book. Same drawings, same actors, pulled from the shared store.
